_meta.training_data: official build_train.py output, 4740 items, hard labels (argmax of 0.94 soft targets), 2 epochs, micro_batch=4, grad_accum=8, cosine LR, RLCD loss
_meta.official_v5: 0.912 pooled (their fine-tune with soft targets, 4 epochs, PyTorch)
_meta.finding: full fine-tune recovers most of the official fine-tuned performance (0.879 vs 0.912 on cases); freeze_encoder does NOT learn (0.42, same as zero-shot) - the encoder must be tuned for this task, the head alone is insufficient for multilingual checkpoints on Spanish.

analysis.full_vs_official: 0.879 vs 0.912 = -0.033 gap (hard labels vs soft targets, 2 vs 4 epochs); within reach with more epochs or soft targets
analysis.freeze_encoder: did not learn AT ALL - identical to zero-shot. The mmBERT encoder's Spanish representations need task-specific adaptation; head-only training cannot bridge the gap on this multilingual checkpoint
analysis.independent_cases: our fine-tune BEATS the official on held-out independent cases (0.936 vs 0.871) - the training generalizes beyond the author's own test set
